plan: The order doesn’t really matter, but I would play fragrant forest, use fragrant forest, play the basic onto my bench, use leaf cape on comber, use field blower to remove deceptive needle. If the basic Pokemon forest gave me was shuckle, I would use x speed to retreat combee and promote shuckle, attach energy to shuckle and attack. If it was a non shuckle basic, I would attach energy to combee and attack.
text: Play Fragrant Forest (Stadium): Once during each player's turn, that player may put a random Basic Grass Pokémon from their deck into their hand.
